caption: Vegetable pieces lie at the bottom of a pot of clear water, and they seem to shift and swim as the water is stirred.

sa.check: Vegetable pieces lie at the bottom of a pot of clear water.
The pieces seem to shift and swim.
They look still again when the stirring stops.

pc.expect: The pieces on the bottom stay put while the moving water makes their images wobble.
pc.fail: The pieces actually slide about; or they change shape; or pieces appear and vanish.

pc.expect: The wobble follows the stirring and stops when the water settles.
pc.fail: The images wobble with the water still; or they are sharp while the water is plainly moving; or the wobble goes on after the water settles.

pc.expect: The pieces are visible through the water.
pc.fail: The water hides them; or a different set appears; or they are seen only above the surface.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: it swirls and settles.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or the swirl freezes; or the water leaps.
Pieces vanish; or appear; or merge.

pc.expect: The pot and the pieces' colours stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes; or the pieces change colour; or the stove changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
